label: SafetyComplianceWorkforce process: Coordinate product and material changes for safety — Align engineering changes and material substitutions with safety requirements to eliminate or reduce hazardous substances in products.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

PURCHASE ORDER & PROCUREMENT:
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 ✓ BEST for safety material ordering
- Enables PO creation, updating, monitoring across supplier networks
- Capabilities: coordinate-vendor-procurement, validate-purchase-orders, verify-vendor-compliance

Agent: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1

WORKFORCE SAFETY & COMPENSATION:
Agent: sap.sf:agent:OccupationalSafetyComplianceMonitor:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1

ENGINEERING & CHANGE MANAGEMENT:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 ✓ BEST for SafetyComplianceWorkforce
- Coordinates engineering changes + material substitutions with compliance requirements
- Capabilities: coordinate-bom-updates, synchronize-engineering-changes, evaluate-change-impact, manage-material-provisioning
- Use case: "Product redesign or material substitution triggered by compliance needs"
- Eliminates/reduces hazardous substances via material substitution in ECO/ECR workflows
- Related entities: EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem

Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1
- Validates BOMs against restricted substance directives
- Recommends approved substitutes

ORDER-TO-PRODUCTION:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1
